metadata.description: Official MemMesh plugins for Claude Code and other agents

plugins.name: memmesh
plugins.description: MemMesh — persistent, local-first memory for AI agents. Bi-temporal knowledge graph, typed/scoped recall, and local↔server sync, over MCP; runs from one binary on SQLite with no mandatory LLM calls (your agent's own model does any extraction). Calibrated prediction & behavior discovery available in hosted mode.
